name: Customer Support Sentiment Analysis (Negative Feedback)
description: Evaluates whether the agent accurately classifies a critical customer complaint into structured JSON matching the sentiment schema.

input.text: Terrible customer service. The package was completely broken, arrived two weeks late, and nobody answered my emails. I hate this store.

customer_messages: Analyze the following feedback and output valid JSON with keys sentiment, score, confidence, and summary: 'Terrible customer service. The package was completely broken, arrived two weeks late, and nobody answered my emails. I hate this store.'

tool_contracts.name: echo_tool
tool_contracts.description: Echoes back input payload for diagnostic testing.

assertions.name: Sentiment JSON Schema Compliance
assertions.description: Validates that agent output contains required sentiment fields with correct types.

assertions.name: Execution Completed Cleanly
assertions.description: Ensures agent finished without timeout or unhandled exceptions.
